source.title: NeuroCoreX: An Open-Source FPGA-Based Spiking Neural Network Emulator with On-Chip Learning

claims.text: Their event-driven nature enables them to achieve high energy efficiency, particularly when deployed on neuromorphic hardware platforms.

claims.text: In this work, we introduce NeuroCoreX, an FPGAbased emulator designed for the flexible co-design and testing of SNNs.
claims.claim_text: In this work, we introduce NeuroCoreX, an FPGAbased emulator designed for the flexible co-design and testing of SNNs.

claims.text: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are computational models inspired by the structure and dynamics of biological neuronal networks.
claims.claim_text: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are computational models inspired by the structure and dynamics of biological neuronal networks.

claims.text: NeuroCoreX supports all-to-all connectivity, providing the capability to implement diverse network topologies without architectural restrictions.
claims.claim_text: NeuroCoreX supports all-to-all connectivity, providing the capability to implement diverse network topologies without architectural restrictions.

claims.text: It features a biologically motivated local learning mechanism based on Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP).
claims.claim_text: It features a biologically motivated local learning mechanism based on Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP).

claims.text: The neuron model implemented within NeuroCoreX is the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) model, with current-based synapses facilitating spike integration and transmission.
claims.claim_text: The neuron model implemented within NeuroCoreX is the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) model, with current-based synapses facilitating spike integration and transmission.

claims.text: In its current implementation, NeuroCoreX supports networks of up to N = 100 neurons with full all-to-all bidirectional connectivity using 10,000 synapses.
claims.claim_text: In its current implementation, NeuroCoreX supports networks of up to N = 100 neurons with full all-to-all bidirectional connectivity using 10,000 synapses.

claims.text: In addition to recurrent connections, the system includes a separate set of 10,000 feedforward input synapses that serve as the interface for external stimuli.

claims.text: FPGA platform NeuroCoreX is implemented on the Artix-7 FPGA, a costeffective and widely available platform that offers sufficient resources for neuromorphic prototyping.
